findings: 3 draft tokens: 23.5 and 22.5 tokens/s against 17.4 and 18.3 dense in the same rounds (+23% to +35%), 54% acceptance, 2.63 tokens per 7B pass.
5 and 7 draft tokens are slower than dense: a 6-8 token verification step costs about three single-token passes.
Every speculative run produced the same token count and acceptance, and the output equals the dense greedy output by construction (ADR-020).
limitations: One prompt; acceptance depends on the text. On the 3,528-token repository-summary prompt acceptance was 27-46% and speculation did not pay off (see the layer-drop memory evidence, runs spec05k*).
